WITH status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(powerstatus, '<missing>') AS power_status_group,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, '<missing>')
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM status_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;
